MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND o.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH o.nationality AS nationality, date_diff('year', CAST(REPLACE(o.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-14')) AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND o.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH o.nationality AS nationality,
     2026 - CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) -
     CASE
       WHEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10
         OR (CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
